<summary>Analysis steps, methods and full verification</summary>

## Tasks

This is the default community-analysis entry for Figures 1 and 2, Supplementary Figures 1 and 2, and Data 1. One source is selected for the complete result set by config/analysis-version.yml and recorded in community-version.tsv:

- **analysis-v2026.09.28.1 (active rebuilt version):** Task 2 calculates composition, alpha diversity, distances/ordinations, PERMANOVA/betadisper, cross-assay associations and host visibility from the 012 TSEs using R/community.R and config/community.yml. Each random calculation is executed once here.
- **render-r3-baseline (historical archived alternative):** read source-project result tables without recalculating them.

Subsequent tasks validate and prepare either source consistently. Displayed values are checked against source tables or config/definitions.tsv and recorded in input-checks.tsv. A failed assertion stops the step.

### Task 1: Read verified inputs

```{r}
#| label: inputs
manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "input-manifest.tsv"))
raw_manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "raw-input-manifest.tsv"))
style <- rwv_style_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/style.yml", manifest))
samples <- rwv_samples_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/samples.tsv", manifest), style)
palettes <- rwv_palettes_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/palettes.yml", manifest))
defs <- rwv_definitions_read(rwv_project_input(step, "config/definitions.tsv", manifest))
raw <- function(f) as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(rwv_raw_input(step, path_data, f, raw_manifest)))
num <- function(x) as.numeric(x)
checks <- rwv_checks_new()
sample_levels <- rwv_sample_levels(samples)
# One switch selects the source of the whole set of community results; there
# is no per-file fallback.
av <- yaml::read_yaml(rwv_project_input(step, "config/analysis-version.yml", manifest))
community_source <- av$versions[[av$active]]
if (!isTRUE(community_source %in% c("archived", "rebuilt"))) rwv_fail("config/analysis-version.yml: unknown active version ", av$active)
community_files <- c("composition_full.tsv", "export_checks.tsv", "feature_taxonomy.tsv", "virome_alpha.tsv", "alpha_summary.tsv",
                     "label_pairs.tsv", "pcoa_aitchison.tsv", "crossomics_pairwise.tsv", "permanova_marginal.tsv",
                     "betadisper_summary.tsv", "viral_load_per_sample.tsv", "virome_depth_check.tsv",
                     "corrected_host_members.tsv", "crispr_host_edges_primary.tsv")
```

### Task 2: Calculate community results for the rebuilt version

Calls follow the scientific-task order in R/community.R. Each random procedure sets its configured seed at its original point. Archived host evidence (200 iPHoP records and 29 strict CRISPR edges) is preserved; only visibility and co-detection summaries are recalculated.

```{r}
#| label: community-calculation
computed <- NULL
if (community_source == "rebuilt") {
  cfg <- yaml::read_yaml(rwv_project_input(step, "config/community.yml", manifest))
  cfg_problems <- rwv_community_config_check(cfg)
  if (length(cfg_problems)) rwv_fail("config/community.yml selects values that are not implemented: ", paste(cfg_problems, collapse = "; "))
  up12 <- function(f) readRDS(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "012-tse-construction", f))
  tse <- list(virome = up12("tse_virome.rds"), bact_16s = up12("tse_16s.rds"),
              euk_18s_all = up12("tse_18s_all.rds"), euk_18s_microeuk = up12("tse_18s_microeuk.rds"))
  archived_evidence <- function(f) utils::read.delim(rwv_raw_input(step, path_data, f, raw_manifest), check.names = FALSE,
                                                     colClasses = "character", na.strings = character(0))
  calc_order <- unlist(cfg$calculation_sample_order)
  rwv_check(checks, "all four TSEs in calculation sample order", TRUE, all(vapply(tse, function(x) identical(colnames(x), calc_order), logical(1))))
  # 2a. Composition: per-assay taxon sums and within-sample shares.
  comp <- rwv_comm_composition(tse, calc_order, checks)
  # 2b. Alpha diversity: amplicons on the rarefied assay; virome by repeated rarefaction.
  alpha_res <- rwv_comm_alpha(tse, cfg, calc_order, checks)
  # 2c. Distances, PCoA, marginal PERMANOVA and betadisper.
  div_res <- rwv_comm_diversity(alpha_res$tse, cfg, calc_order, comp$comp_checks)
  # 2d. Cross-assay covariation (Procrustes, Mantel, RV).
  cross_res <- rwv_comm_crossomics(div_res$div, cfg, calc_order)
  # 2e. Host visibility and co-detection on the archived host evidence.
  host_res <- rwv_comm_hosts(alpha_res$tse, up12("tse_16s_filtered.rds"), archived_evidence("corrected_host_members.tsv"),
                             archived_evidence("crispr_host_edges_primary.tsv"), cfg, calc_order, checks)
  computed <- list(composition_full = comp$composition_full, export_checks = div_res$export_checks, feature_taxonomy = comp$feature_taxonomy,
                   virome_alpha = alpha_res$virome_alpha, alpha_summary = alpha_res$alpha_summary, label_pairs = alpha_res$label_pairs,
                   pcoa_aitchison = div_res$pcoa_aitchison, crossomics_pairwise = cross_res$crossomics_pairwise,
                   permanova_marginal = div_res$permanova_marginal, betadisper_summary = div_res$betadisper_summary,
                   viral_load_per_sample = alpha_res$viral_load_per_sample, virome_depth_check = alpha_res$virome_depth_check,
                   corrected_host_members = host_res$corrected_host_members, crispr_host_edges_primary = host_res$crispr_host_edges_primary)
  # Records of this calculation (optional outputs of the rebuilt version).
  rwv_write_tsv(rwv_comm_rng_record(cfg, rbind(div_res$perm_log, cross_res$perm_log)), path_target("rng-record.tsv"))
  rwv_write_tsv(rbind(comp$prov, alpha_res$prov, div_res$prov, cross_res$prov, host_res$prov), path_target("community-provenance.tsv"))
  rwv_write_tsv(div_res$pcoa_eigen, path_target("pcoa-eigen.tsv"))
  saveRDS(div_res$distances, path_target("distances.rds"))
  print(knitr::kable(alpha_res$alpha_summary[, c("experiment", "sample_id", "observed", "shannon", "pielou", "faith")], digits = 3,
                     row.names = FALSE, caption = "Amplicon alpha diversity (rarefied assay)"))
  print(knitr::kable(alpha_res$virome_alpha[, c("sample_id", "masked_reads", "rarefy_depth", "observed", "shannon", "shannon_sd")], digits = 3,
                     row.names = FALSE, caption = "Virome alpha diversity (mean of 100 rarefactions)"))
  print(knitr::kable(div_res$permanova_marginal, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Marginal PERMANOVA (999 permutations)"))
  print(knitr::kable(div_res$betadisper_summary[, c("experiment", "diss_x_group", "p_betadisper_permutation",
                                                    "p_betadisper_permutation_bias_adjusted", "dispersion_status")],
                     digits = 4, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Dispersion checks (betadisper)"))
  print(knitr::kable(cross_res$crossomics_pairwise[, c("pair", "mantel_r", "mantel_p", "proc_corr", "proc_p", "rv_coef")], digits = 3,
                     caption = "Cross-assay covariation"))
} else {
  cat("Active version", av$active, "uses the archived community tables; no calculation in this run.\n")
}
# Each community table is taken from the active source. Rebuilt tables pass
# through the same TSV reader as the archived ones, so both sources are
# parsed identically by the tasks below.
community_log <- list()
comm <- function(f) {
  if (!f %in% community_files) rwv_fail(f, " is not a community table")
  if (community_source == "rebuilt") {
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".tsv")
    rwv_write_tsv(computed[[sub("\\.tsv$", "", f)]], tmp)
    path <- tmp; read_from <- "computed in this step (Task 2)"
  } else {
    path <- rwv_raw_input(step, path_data, f, raw_manifest)
    read_from <- paste0("analyses/data/00-raw/d020-community-analysis/", f)
  }
  community_log[[f]] <<- data.frame(file = f, active_version = av$active, source = community_source, read_from = read_from,
                                    sha256 = rwv_sha256(path))
  as.data.frame(rwv_read_tsv(path))
}
```

### Task 3: Validate sample dictionary and metadata

Site labels in config/samples.tsv are derived from ID prefixes and checked against the archived S1 sample metadata. The c/d identifiers retain their recorded clean/dirty water_condition labels; they do not establish a before/after treatment design.

```{r}
#| label: samples
meta <- raw("sample_metadata.tsv")
meta <- meta[match(sample_levels, meta$sample_id), , drop = FALSE]
rwv_check(checks, "sample IDs in metadata equal config order", sample_levels, meta$sample_id, source = "sample_metadata.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "metadata location equals config site", as.character(samples$site), meta$location, source = "sample_metadata.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "samples", nrow(meta), "sample_metadata.tsv")
samples_out <- data.frame(
  sample_id = sample_levels, sample_order = samples$sample_order, site = as.character(samples$site),
  site_colour = unname(rwv_site_colours(style)[as.character(samples$site)]),
  record_label = meta$water_condition, description = meta$desc,
  id_virome = meta$id_virome, id_16s = meta$id_16s, id_18s = meta$id_18s,
  clean_reads_virome = meta$clean_reads_virome, raw_reads_virome = meta$raw_reads_virome,
  label_note = "c/d = recorded clean/dirty label; sample descriptions: d, treatment-process water; c, nearby water after facility outflow; not verified hydraulic pairs or a before/after treatment; bc2 has no designated d counterpart"
)
rwv_write_tsv(samples_out, path_target("samples.tsv"))
knitr::kable(samples_out[, 1:8])
```

### Task 4: Prepare three-assay composition and display aggregation

Display aggregation retains all viral classes. For 16S and microeukaryotes, the eight named taxa with highest mean relative abundance across seven samples are retained, with ties ordered by name; other named taxa are grouped as Other and Unclassified remains separate. The full 59-category table and display mapping are retained.

```{r}
#| label: composition
comp <- comm("composition_full.tsv")
comp$relative_abundance <- num(comp$relative_abundance)
comp$abundance_sum <- num(comp$abundance_sum)
omics <- c("virome", "bact_16s", "euk_18s_microeuk")
rwv_check(checks, "composition rows", 413, nrow(comp), source = "composition_full.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "composition omics", omics, unique(comp$omic), source = "composition_full.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "composition samples (sorted)", sort(sample_levels), sort(unique(comp$sample_id)), source = "composition_full.tsv")
sums <- tapply(comp$relative_abundance, paste(comp$omic, comp$sample_id), sum)
rwv_check(checks, "every omic x sample sums to 1", rep(1, 21), unname(sums), tol = 1e-9, source = "composition_full.tsv")
n_taxa <- tapply(comp$taxon, comp$omic, function(x) length(unique(x)))[omics]
rwv_check(checks, "taxa per omic (virome, 16S, microeuk)", c(8, 38, 13), unname(n_taxa), source = "composition_full.tsv")
checks_export <- comm("export_checks.tsv")
# Hash chain: the production-input exports staged here must be the files the
# export manifest recorded (independent of this step's own copy).
if (community_source == "archived") {
  pim <- jsonlite::read_json(rwv_raw_input(step, path_data, "production_input_manifest.json", raw_manifest))
  staged_sha <- function(f) raw_manifest$origin_sha256[basename(raw_manifest$path) == f & raw_manifest$consumer_step == step$name]
  for (f in c("composition_full.tsv", "feature_taxonomy.tsv", "pcoa_aitchison.tsv", "export_checks.tsv")) {
    rwv_check(checks, paste("production manifest hash of", f), pim$outputs_sha256[[f]], staged_sha(f),
              source = "production-inputs/input-manifest.json")
  }
}
ftax <- comm("feature_taxonomy.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "feature-to-taxon mappings", 6998, nrow(ftax), source = "production-inputs/README.md")
rwv_check(checks, "features per assay equal export_checks.tsv", num(checks_export$source_features),
          as.numeric(table(ftax$omic)[checks_export$omic]), source = "export_checks.tsv")
rwv_write_tsv(ftax, path_target("feature_taxonomy.tsv"))
rwv_check(checks, "taxa per omic equal export_checks.tsv", num(checks_export$taxonomy_groups), unname(as.numeric(n_taxa)),
          source = "export_checks.tsv")

map_rows <- list()
for (o in omics) {
  x <- comp[comp$omic == o, ]
  mean_rel <- tapply(x$relative_abundance, x$taxon, sum) / length(sample_levels)
  taxa <- names(mean_rel)
  named <- taxa[taxa != "Unclassified"]
  ord <- named[order(-mean_rel[named], named)]
  keep <- if (o == "virome") ord else head(ord, 8)
  display <- ifelse(taxa == "Unclassified", "Unclassified", ifelse(taxa %in% keep, taxa, "Other"))
  rank_named <- match(taxa, ord)
  map_rows[[o]] <- data.frame(
    omic = o, taxon = taxa, mean_relative_abundance = unname(mean_rel), rank_among_named = rank_named,
    display_category = display,
    rule = if (o == "virome") "all classes kept; Unclassified separate" else
      "top 8 named by 7-sample mean relative abundance (ties by name); other named -> Other; Unclassified separate"
  )
  expected <- names(palettes$taxa[[o]])
  rwv_check(checks, paste0(o, ": displayed named taxa equal config/palettes.yml"), expected, keep, source = "palettes.yml")
}
taxon_map <- do.call(rbind, map_rows)
taxon_map <- taxon_map[order(match(taxon_map$omic, omics), is.na(taxon_map$rank_among_named),
                             taxon_map$rank_among_named), ]
rownames(taxon_map) <- NULL
comp$display_category <- taxon_map$display_category[match(paste(comp$omic, comp$taxon), paste(taxon_map$omic, taxon_map$taxon))]
disp <- aggregate(list(relative_abundance = comp$relative_abundance),
                  list(omic = comp$omic, sample_id = comp$sample_id, display_category = comp$display_category), sum)
dsum <- tapply(disp$relative_abundance, paste(disp$omic, disp$sample_id), sum)
rwv_check(checks, "display categories still sum to 1", rep(1, 21), unname(dsum), tol = 1e-9, source = "derived")
disp <- disp[order(match(disp$omic, omics), match(disp$sample_id, sample_levels), disp$display_category), ]
rownames(disp) <- NULL
rwv_write_tsv(comp, path_target("composition_full.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(taxon_map, path_target("taxon_display_map.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(disp, path_target("composition_display.tsv"))
knitr::kable(taxon_map[taxon_map$display_category != "Other", c("omic", "taxon", "mean_relative_abundance", "display_category")], digits = 4)
```

### Task 5: Shannon diversity and same-site record pairs

Viral Shannon uses the dev390 breadth >= 75% masked, rarefied shannon field. The 16S and microeukaryote values use the 060 shannon field, excluding euk_18s_all. The SD across 100 rarefactions is technical variation, not a biological uncertainty interval.

```{r}
#| label: alpha
va <- comm("virome_alpha.tsv")
if (community_source == "archived") {
  alpha_script <- readLines(rwv_raw_input(step, path_data, "virome_alpha_script.R", raw_manifest), warn = FALSE)
  rwv_check(checks, "masking rule in the script that produced virome_alpha.tsv", TRUE,
            any(grepl("breadth < 75%", alpha_script, fixed = TRUE)), source = "dev/390 virome_alpha.R line 3")
  rwv_check(checks, "rarefaction repeats in that script", TRUE,
            any(grepl("n_iter <- 100", alpha_script, fixed = TRUE)), source = "dev/390 virome_alpha.R line 20")
} else {
  cc <- yaml::read_yaml(rwv_project_input(step, "config/community.yml", manifest))
  rwv_check(checks, "breadth mask and rarefaction repeats used by Task 2", c(0.75, 100),
            c(cc$virome$detect_covered_fraction, cc$virome$alpha_iterations), source = "config/community.yml")
}
rwv_check(checks, "saved rarefaction depth (reads)", 1648195, unique(num(va$rarefy_depth)), source = "virome_alpha.tsv")
aa <- comm("alpha_summary.tsv")
alpha <- rbind(
  data.frame(omic = "virome", sample_id = va$sample_id, shannon = num(va$shannon), observed = num(va$observed),
             definition = "breadth>=75% count_masked; mean of 100 rarefactions to 1,648,195 reads (computed in 020; checked in 014 against dev/390 virome_alpha.tsv)"),
  # 16S was rarefied to 63,564 reads. The 18S table was rarefied to 53,257
  # reads and Metazoa were removed afterwards, so the retained microeukaryote
  # totals are not equal across samples (SI Note 2 of the source project).
  data.frame(omic = aa$experiment, sample_id = aa$sample_id, shannon = num(aa$shannon), observed = num(aa$observed),
             definition = c(bact_16s = "rarefied 16S assay, 63,564 reads per sample (computed in 012/020; checked in 014 against 060-diversity)",
                            euk_18s_microeuk = "full 18S table rarefied (53,257 reads per sample) before Metazoa were removed; retained microeukaryote totals therefore need not be equal among samples (computed in 012/020; checked in 014 against 060-diversity)")[
                              aa$experiment])[aa$experiment %in% c("bact_16s", "euk_18s_microeuk"), ]
)
alpha <- alpha[order(match(alpha$omic, omics), match(alpha$sample_id, sample_levels)), ]
rownames(alpha) <- NULL
rwv_check(checks, "alpha rows (3 omics x 7)", 21, nrow(alpha), source = "virome_alpha.tsv + alpha_summary.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "alpha has no NA", FALSE, anyNA(alpha$shannon))
# The two amplicon rarefaction depths written into the alpha dictionary come
# from the registered definition (030 checks them against the staged
# supplementary information, which is that step's raw input).
amp <- strsplit(as.character(rwv_def(defs, "amplicon_rarefaction")), "/")[[1]]
rwv_check(checks, "16S and full-18S rarefaction depths in the alpha definitions",
          amp, gsub(",", "", c(sub(".*?([0-9,]+) reads per sample.*", "\\1", alpha$definition[alpha$omic == "bact_16s"][1]),
                               sub(".*?\\(([0-9,]+) reads per sample\\).*", "\\1", alpha$definition[alpha$omic == "euk_18s_microeuk"][1])), fixed = TRUE),
          source = "definitions.tsv amplicon_rarefaction")
pairs <- comm("label_pairs.tsv")
# Clean/dirty samples of each saved pair are looked up from the sample
# metadata (description names the site; water_condition is the record label).
site_pairs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(pairs$pair), function(pr) {
  hit <- meta[grepl(pr, meta$desc, fixed = TRUE), ]
  data.frame(pair = pr, clean = hit$sample_id[hit$water_condition == "clean"],
             dirty = hit$sample_id[hit$water_condition == "dirty"])
}))
rwv_check(checks, "one clean and one dirty sample per saved pair", rep(3, 2),
          c(length(unique(site_pairs$clean)), length(unique(site_pairs$dirty))), source = "sample_metadata.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "unpaired sample", "bc2", setdiff(sample_levels, c(site_pairs$clean, site_pairs$dirty)),
          source = "sample_metadata.tsv")
pair_rows <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
  p <- pairs[i, ]
  sp <- site_pairs[site_pairs$pair == p$pair, ]
  a <- alpha[alpha$omic == p$experiment, ]
  diff <- a$shannon[a$sample_id == sp$dirty] - a$shannon[a$sample_id == sp$clean]
  rwv_check(checks, paste("saved Shannon dirty - clean", p$experiment, p$pair), num(p$shannon_diff_dirty_minus_clean), diff,
            tol = 1e-9, source = "clean_dirty_pairs.tsv (sign: dirty minus clean)")
  pair_rows[[i]] <- data.frame(omic = p$experiment, pair = p$pair, clean_sample = sp$clean, dirty_sample = sp$dirty,
                               shannon_clean = num(p$shannon_clean), shannon_dirty = num(p$shannon_dirty),
                               shannon_diff_dirty_minus_clean = num(p$shannon_diff_dirty_minus_clean))
}
label_pairs <- do.call(rbind, pair_rows)
v <- label_pairs$shannon_diff_dirty_minus_clean[label_pairs$omic == "virome"]
rwv_check(checks, "virome Shannon differences (rounded 3 dp)", c(-0.320, 2.168, 0.423), round(v, 3), tol = 1e-12)
rwv_write_tsv(alpha, path_target("alpha.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(label_pairs, path_target("label_pairs.tsv"))
virome_alpha <- data.frame(va[, c("sample_id", "masked_reads", "rarefy_depth", "observed", "shannon", "observed_sd", "shannon_sd",
                                  "observed_unrarefied", "shannon_unrarefied")])
rwv_write_tsv(virome_alpha, path_target("virome_alpha_detail.tsv"))
knitr::kable(label_pairs, digits = 3)
```

### Task 6: Saved Aitchison PCoA coordinates

```{r}
#| label: pcoa
pc <- comm("pcoa_aitchison.tsv")
for (k in c("PCoA1", "PCoA2", "axis1_percent", "axis2_percent")) pc[[k]] <- num(pc[[k]])
rwv_check(checks, "PCoA rows", 21, nrow(pc), source = "pcoa_aitchison.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "axis percentages already in 0-100 (not x100 again)", TRUE,
          all(pc$axis1_percent > 1 & pc$axis1_percent < 100 & pc$axis2_percent > 1 & pc$axis2_percent < 100))
rwv_check(checks, "axis percentages equal export_checks.tsv", num(c(checks_export$axis1_percent, checks_export$axis2_percent)),
          c(tapply(pc$axis1_percent, pc$omic, unique)[checks_export$omic], tapply(pc$axis2_percent, pc$omic, unique)[checks_export$omic]),
          tol = 1e-9, source = "export_checks.tsv")
pc <- pc[order(match(pc$omic, omics), match(pc$sample_id, sample_levels)), ]
rownames(pc) <- NULL
rwv_write_tsv(pc, path_target("pcoa.tsv"))
```

### Task 7: Cross-assay associations, PERMANOVA and dispersion

```{r}
#| label: crossomics
xo <- comm("crossomics_pairwise.tsv")
for (k in c("proc_m2", "proc_corr", "proc_p", "mantel_r", "mantel_p", "rv_coef")) xo[[k]] <- num(xo[[k]])
rwv_check(checks, "Mantel r (6 dp)", c(0.415584, 0.128571, 0.698701), round(xo$mantel_r, 6), source = "crossomics_pairwise.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "Mantel p (nominal)", c(0.115, 0.328, 0.002), xo$mantel_p, source = "crossomics_pairwise.tsv")
xo$method_note <- "Mantel: Spearman, 999 permutations, seed 42, nominal p (no BH); Procrustes: full-rank; RV coefficient; Aitchison = Euclidean on CLR"
rwv_write_tsv(xo, path_target("crossomics.tsv"))
pm <- comm("permanova_marginal.tsv")
bd <- comm("betadisper_summary.tsv")
pv <- function(e, d, t) num(pm$p[pm$experiment == e & pm$dissimilarity == d & pm$term == t])
rwv_check(checks, "virome location p: Aitchison, Bray, Jaccard", c(0.725, 0.001, 0.002),
          c(pv("virome", "aitchison", "location"), pv("virome", "bray", "location"), pv("virome", "jaccard", "location")),
          source = "permanova_marginal.tsv")
rwv_write_tsv(pm, path_target("permanova.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(bd, path_target("betadisper.tsv"))
knitr::kable(xo[, c("pair", "mantel_r", "mantel_p", "proc_corr", "proc_p", "rv_coef")], digits = 3)
```

### Task 8: Depth-related context

```{r}
#| label: depth
load <- comm("viral_load_per_sample.tsv")
dc <- comm("virome_depth_check.tsv")
depth <- data.frame(sample_id = sample_levels)
depth$masked_richness <- num(va$observed_unrarefied[match(sample_levels, va$sample_id)])
depth$masked_reads <- num(va$masked_reads[match(sample_levels, va$sample_id)])
depth$mapped_viral_reads <- num(load$mapped_viral_reads[match(sample_levels, load$sample_id)])
depth$clean_reads <- num(load$clean_reads[match(sample_levels, load$sample_id)])
rwv_check(checks, "masked_reads equals mapped_viral_reads", depth$mapped_viral_reads, depth$masked_reads,
          source = "virome_alpha.tsv vs viral_load_per_sample.tsv")
rho <- num(dc$spearman_rho[dc$metric == "observed_unrarefied~mapped_viral_reads"])
rwv_check(checks, "saved rho richness ~ mapped reads (3 dp), n = 7", 0.857, round(rho, 3), source = "depth_check.tsv")
rwv_write_tsv(depth, path_target("depth.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(dc, path_target("depth_check.tsv"))
```

### Task 9: Host records: iPHoP and strict CRISPR with separate denominators

```{r}
#| label: hosts
hm <- comm("corrected_host_members.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "iphop_records", nrow(hm), "corrected_host_members.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "iPHoP vOTU IDs unique", nrow(hm), length(unique(hm$vOTU_id)))
tab <- table(hm$visibility_status)
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "iphop_visible", unname(tab["named_genus_detected_in_16s"]), "corrected_host_members.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "iphop_not_detected", unname(tab["named_genus_not_detected_in_16s"]), "corrected_host_members.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "iphop_unresolved", unname(tab["genus_unresolved"]), "corrected_host_members.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "in_127 flag agrees with status", sum(hm$in_127_named_visible_set == "1"), unname(tab["named_genus_detected_in_16s"]))
rwv_write_tsv(hm, path_target("host_iphop.tsv"))
cr <- comm("crispr_host_edges_primary.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "crispr_edges", nrow(cr), "crispr_host_edges_primary.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "CRISPR edges all is_primary", TRUE, all(cr$is_primary == "True"))
rwv_check(checks, "CRISPR vOTUs / genera", c(25, 22), c(length(unique(cr$vOTU_id)), length(unique(cr$host_genus))))
rwv_check(checks, "CRISPR host genus visible in 16S (edges)", 16, sum(cr$host_visible_in_16s == "True"))
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "crispr_codetected", sum(num(cr$n_codetected_masked) > 0), "crispr_host_edges_primary.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "crispr_codetected_raw", sum(num(cr$n_codetected_raw) > 0), "crispr_host_edges_primary.tsv")
keep <- c("vOTU_id", "vcontig_id", "host_genus", "host_family", "host_order", "host_phylum", "overall_confidence",
          "crispr_component_score", "min_mismatches", "perfect_match", "host_visible_in_16s", "n_codetected_masked",
          "n_codetected_raw", "carries_VF", "is_primary")
rwv_write_tsv(cr[, keep], path_target("host_crispr_edges.tsv"))
# Per-sample co-detection detail (Data 1 S49), built from the 012 TSEs with the
# same presence rules for either analysis version. Every per-record sum must
# reproduce the saved counts above, so the table cannot drift from Figure 2d.
{
  tse12 <- function(f) readRDS(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "012-tse-construction", f))
  cds <- rwv_comm_host_codetection(tse12("tse_virome.rds"), tse12("tse_16s.rds"), tse12("tse_16s_filtered.rds"),
                                   hm, cr, sample_levels)
  cds <- cds[order(cds$endpoint != "iPHoP record (score >= 90)", cds$vOTU_id, cds$host_genus,
                   match(cds$sample_id, sample_levels)), ]
  rwv_check(checks, "per-sample co-detection: 7 rows per iPHoP record and per CRISPR edge", 7 * (nrow(hm) + nrow(cr)), nrow(cds))
  ch <- cds[cds$endpoint == "iPHoP record (score >= 90)", ]
  sum_h <- tapply(ch$codetected, ch$vOTU_id, function(v) sum(v, na.rm = TRUE))[hm$vOTU_id]
  vis_h <- hm$visibility_status == "named_genus_detected_in_16s"
  rwv_check(checks, "per-sample co-detection reproduces n_codetected_saved (127 visible iPHoP records)", num(hm$n_codetected_saved[vis_h]),
            unname(as.numeric(sum_h[vis_h])))
  rwv_check(checks, "no co-detection for iPHoP records whose genus is absent from 16S or unresolved", 0, sum(sum_h[!vis_h]))
  rwv_check(checks, "unresolved iPHoP genera stay NA, not FALSE", 7 * sum(hm$visibility_status == "genus_unresolved"),
            sum(is.na(ch$genus_detected_16s)))
  cc <- cds[cds$endpoint == "strict CRISPR edge", ]
  sum_c <- tapply(cc$codetected, paste(cc$vOTU_id, sub("^g__", "", cc$host_genus)), sum)[paste(cr$vOTU_id, cr$host_genus)]
  rwv_check(checks, "per-sample co-detection reproduces n_codetected_masked (29 CRISPR edges)", num(cr$n_codetected_masked),
            unname(as.numeric(sum_c)))
  rwv_write_tsv(cds, path_target("host_codetection_by_sample.tsv"))
  # Read-subsampling curves within the retained count tables (Supplementary Fig. 1c,
  # Data 1 S50; 2026-10-11): analytical rarefaction expectation, interpolated only.
  micro_ids <- rownames(tse12("tse_18s_microeuk.rds"))
  curves <- rwv_comm_rarefaction_curves(tse12("tse_virome.rds"), tse12("tse_16s_filtered.rds"), tse12("tse_18s_all.rds"),
                                        micro_ids, sample_levels,
                                        common_depth = list(virome_masked = 1648195, bact_16s = 63564, euk_18s_microeuk = 53257))
  ce <- curves[curves$depth_reads == curves$sample_total_reads, ]
  rwv_check(checks, "curves: 4 layers x 7 samples, each ending at its observed total", 28L, nrow(ce))
  rwv_check(checks, "curves: masked-virome end = masked richness of the alpha analysis",
            as.numeric(depth$masked_richness[match(ce$sample_id[ce$layer == "virome_masked"], depth$sample_id)]),
            ce$observed_features[ce$layer == "virome_masked"])
  rwv_check(checks, "curves: masked-virome expectation at 1,648,195 reads equals the full masked richness (alpha unchanged by rarefaction)",
            ce$observed_features[ce$layer == "virome_masked"],
            round(curves$expected_features[curves$layer == "virome_masked" & curves$is_common_depth], 6))
  rwv_check(checks, "curves: common depths are within every sample total for the masked virome and amplicons", TRUE,
            all(curves$sample_total_reads[!is.na(curves$common_depth)] >= curves$common_depth[!is.na(curves$common_depth)]))
  rwv_write_tsv(curves, path_target("rarefaction_curves.tsv"))
}
```

### Task 10: Five CheckV quality categories for all 3,060 members

votu_contig_map.tsv is the read-only vOTU-to-representative-contig mapping extracted from p0061.sqlite. CheckV categories come from quality_summary.tsv; Not-determined is displayed as Undetermined with the mapping retained.

```{r}
#| label: checkv
vm <- raw("votu_contig_map.tsv")
qs <- raw("checkv_quality_summary.tsv")
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "catalogue_votu", nrow(vm), "votu_contig_map.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "vOTU and contig IDs unique", c(3060, 3060), c(length(unique(vm$vOTU_id)), length(unique(vm$vcontig_id))))
q <- qs[match(vm$vcontig_id, qs$contig_id), ]
rwv_check(checks, "every representative contig found in CheckV", FALSE, anyNA(q$contig_id))
rwv_check(checks, "contig length equals CheckV contig_length", num(vm$contig_length), num(q$contig_length))
display <- c("Complete" = "Complete", "High-quality" = "High-quality", "Medium-quality" = "Medium-quality",
             "Low-quality" = "Low-quality", "Not-determined" = "Undetermined")
cat_ <- data.frame(
  vOTU_id = vm$vOTU_id, vcontig_id = vm$vcontig_id, contig_length_bp = num(vm$contig_length),
  checkv_quality_source = q$checkv_quality, checkv_quality = unname(display[q$checkv_quality]),
  checkv_completeness_pct = suppressWarnings(num(q$completeness)), completeness_method = q$completeness_method,
  checkv_provirus = q$provirus, checkv_quality_score_db = num(vm$checkv_quality_score),
  genomad_n_genes = num(vm$genomad_n_genes)
)
rwv_check(checks, "no CheckV class outside the five", FALSE, anyNA(cat_$checkv_quality))
score_map <- c("1" = "Complete", "2" = "High-quality", "3" = "Medium-quality", "4" = "Low-quality", "5" = "Undetermined")
rwv_check(checks, "database quality score agrees with CheckV class", cat_$checkv_quality,
          unname(score_map[as.character(cat_$checkv_quality_score_db)]))
tab <- table(factor(cat_$checkv_quality, levels = names(palettes$checkv)))
class_defs <- c(Complete = "checkv_complete", `High-quality` = "checkv_high", `Medium-quality` = "checkv_medium",
                `Low-quality` = "checkv_low", Undetermined = "checkv_undetermined")
for (cls in names(class_defs)) {
  rwv_check_def(checks, defs, class_defs[[cls]], unname(as.numeric(tab[cls])), "CheckV quality_summary via vOTU map")
}
funnel <- raw("denominator_funnel.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "five classes equal the denominator ledger", num(funnel$n[grepl("^S2_checkv", funnel$stage)]),
          unname(as.numeric(tab)), source = "F1_denominator_funnel_inputs.tsv")
rwv_check(checks, "Undetermined == completeness NA", sum(cat_$checkv_quality == "Undetermined"), sum(is.na(cat_$checkv_completeness_pct)))
rwv_check(checks, "length range (bp)", c(10005, 158264), range(cat_$contig_length_bp))
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "vf_model_n", sum(!is.na(cat_$checkv_completeness_pct)), "3060 - 47 completeness NA")
rwv_write_tsv(cat_, path_target("checkv_catalogue.tsv"))
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(tab), col.names = c("CheckV class", "vOTUs"))
```

### Task 11: Saved saturation diagnostics on the historical unmasked basis

The historical 115 sample rarefaction curves were saved as PNGs without point-level values. This task migrates their saved endpoint diagnostics without rerunning vegan::rarefy. They use unmasked positive counts, a different basis from dev390 masked alpha diversity.

```{r}
#| label: saturation
sat <- raw("saturation_diagnostics.tsv")
sat$omic <- c("Virome (vOTUs)" = "virome", "16S bacteria (ASVs)" = "bact_16s",
              "18S microeukaryotes (ASVs)" = "euk_18s_microeuk")[sat$layer]
rwv_check(checks, "saturation rows (3 x 7)", 21, nrow(sat))
rwv_check(checks, "saturation layers mapped", FALSE, anyNA(sat$omic))
sat$definition <- ifelse(sat$omic == "virome", "unmasked positive counts (SQLite virus_abundance_count); not the masked alpha definition",
                         "retained amplicon count table")
rwv_write_tsv(sat, path_target("saturation.tsv"))
gaps <- data.frame(
  item = c("read-rarefaction curve values", "rarefaction curve with the masked alpha definition"),
  status = c("not exported: only PNG files analyses/data/115-supp-qc/figures/panel_a_rarefaction.png and panel_i_crossomic_rarefaction.png in the source project",
             "not done in the source project"),
  consequence = c("S1 shows saved end-point diagnostics; curves are not redrawn (re-running vegan::rarefy is outside this task)",
                  "masked alpha saturation cannot be claimed from the unmasked curves")
)
rwv_write_tsv(gaps, path_target("community-gaps.tsv"))
community_version <- do.call(rbind, community_log)
rownames(community_version) <- NULL
rwv_check(checks, "every community table read from the single active source", length(community_files), nrow(community_version))
rwv_write_tsv(community_version, path_target("community-version.tsv"))
# With the rebuilt version the archived community tables (and the provenance
# files that only describe them) stay registered but are not read; they are
# hash-checked and recorded as not used rather than silently skipped.
if (community_source == "rebuilt") {
  rwv_raw_not_used(step, path_data, c(setdiff(community_files, c("corrected_host_members.tsv", "crispr_host_edges_primary.tsv")),
                                      "production_input_manifest.json", "virome_alpha_script.R"), raw_manifest)
}
knitr::kable(gaps)
```

### Task 11b: Seven-sample detection intersections and abundance contributions

Using the 012 viral TSE and the existing breadth rule, each vOTU receives a seven-bit detection pattern. The catalogue table retains members qualifying in no sample; the display table includes nonempty patterns. Abundance denominators remain each sample's complete masked catalogue, without intersection-specific renormalization or substituting seven-sample sharing for same-site comparisons.

```{r}
#| label: seven-sample-sharing
sharing_cfg <- yaml::read_yaml(rwv_project_input(step, "config/community.yml", manifest))
sharing_tse <- readRDS(rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "012-tse-construction", "tse_virome.rds"))
sharing <- rwv_comm_votu_sharing(sharing_tse, sample_levels, sharing_cfg, checks)
rwv_check_def(checks, defs, "catalogue_votu", nrow(sharing$members), "012 TSE and sharing register")
rwv_check(checks, "observed nonempty sharing patterns (registered dataset regression)", 26L, nrow(sharing$patterns),
          source = "2026-10-15 independent saved-TSE descriptive audit; not a threshold or model choice")
rwv_check(checks, "sharing sample summary follows the configured seven-sample order", sample_levels, sharing$samples$sample_id)
rwv_write_tsv(sharing$patterns, path_target("votu_sharing_patterns.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(sharing$samples, path_target("votu_sharing_samples.tsv"))
rwv_write_tsv(sharing$members, path_target("votu_sharing_members.tsv"))
knitr::kable(sharing$samples[, c("sample_id", "qualifying_vOTUs", "sample_only_vOTUs", "shared_vOTUs",
                                "sample_only_catalogue_percent", "shared_catalogue_percent")], digits = 2)
```
